# The full category generated by fixed vectors

Worker 1649. This internal categorical helper uses exactly the invariant-submodule criterion
in `StandardFixedVectorHeckeEquivalenceStatement`. It is motivated by Renard
2026, I.3.2 (printed pp.19–22 / PDF pp.25–28) and VI.9.4
(printed pp.200–201 / PDF pp.206–207). No reductive-group assertion is claimed here.

The inverse image of an invariant submodule proves that generation by fixed
vectors passes to quotients. An actual algebraic direct sum is generated by its
summands, so it too is generated by fixed vectors. These direct sums give all
coproducts indexed in the carrier universe. Closure under isomorphisms transfers
this to arbitrary categorical coproducts. In the preadditive ambient category,
a binary product is also a binary coproduct. The zero representation is
generated by fixed vectors. Consequently the full subcategory is abelian
provided it is closed under subobjects. That closure remains an explicit input;
it is the substantive reductive-group assertion of VI.9.4.
